title: Task-Level Natural Language Priors as Learning Signals for Low-Resource LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.02244v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often struggle when low-resource training data are ambiguous or incomplete. Task-level natural-language priors can provide useful guidance in such settings, but existing approaches usually treat these priors as input context rather than as learning signals during training. We propose Prior-Guided Tuning (PGT), a training perspective that incorporates natural-language priors as auxiliary learning signals for low-resource LLM training. Under this perspective, we introduce Contrastive Prior Steering (CPS), which keeps the original supervised objective intact while adding positive and negative prior-conditioned auxiliary losses to encourage task-consistent learning and discourage plausible but misleading alternatives. translated_title: 任务级自然语言先验作为低资源大语言模型训练的学习信号
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在低资源训练数据模糊或不完整时往往表现不佳。任务级自然语言先验可以在此类场景中提供有用的指导，但现有方法通常将这些先验视为输入上下文，而非训练过程中的学习信号。我们提出了先验引导微调，这是一种新的训练视角，将自然语言先验作为辅助学习信号融入低资源LLM训练中。在该视角下，我们引入了对比先验引导，它在保持原始监督目标不变的同时，添加基于正负先验条件的辅助损失，以鼓励与任务一致的学习，并抑制看似合理但具有误导性的替代方案。在AmbiMath、Jigsaw以及MNLI/HANS数据集上的实验表明，CPS持续优于普通微调和提示微调。在AmbiMath数据集上，CPS达到了97.6%的平均精确匹配准确率。
tldr: 本文提出先验引导微调训练视角及对比先验引导方法，将任务级自然语言先验作为辅助学习信号融入低资源LLM训练，在保持原监督目标的同时提升模型性能，在多个数据集上持续优于普通微调和提示微调。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Prior-Guided Tuning (PGT) with Contrastive Prior Steering (CPS), which leverages task-level natural language priors as auxiliary learning signals for low-resource LLM training, consistently outperforming plain and prompt fine-tuning across multiple benchmarks while keeping the original supervised objective intact.
